subject.title: feat(android): add staged Wear status bridge

question: Should this phone-first status-only bridge become OpenClaw's canonical first Wear milestone instead of the broader implementation in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/47604?
rationale: The two branches make materially different authentication, release, and feature-scope choices; code review cannot select the permanent Wear product boundary without Android-owner intent.

options.title: Adopt staged bridge
options.body: Use this credential-free status slice as the first milestone after fixing artifact versioning, release handling, and device proof.

options.title: Continue broad MVP
options.body: Keep the existing chat-capable Wear PR canonical and close or reshape this overlapping branch.

options.title: Pause Wear delivery
options.body: Defer both implementations until Android release ownership and recurring phone/watch QA are available.

recommendation.title: Adopt staged bridge
recommendation.body: Use this credential-free status slice as the first milestone after fixing artifact versioning, release handling, and device proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository documentation explicitly assigns Android app ownership to this maintainer, making them the best available owner for the Wear product and release boundary.
